en: Furniture lasts a lifetime, so even if it
costs a bit more, you've got to buy quality.
We do installment plans too, so you can
buy without worrying.
You've been coming by quite a lot, but
haven't you found anything you like?
We take custom orders too, you know.
I'll make anything you'd like.
(Perhaps I'll order a new coffin.)
What sort of furniture would you like?
There's been a death in my family lately.
Make me one fine coffin, would you...
Right you are.
With all the deaths at the factory lately,
I've been getting lots of coffin orders.
I've been expecting you.
Here's the coffin you ordered.
I'll deliver it to the place you asked.
Hm. This is rather well made.
If there's anything else, just say the word.
I take real pride in my furniture's finish.
Why not order something else, too?
Come back when the shop's open, okay?
Anything at all...?
At my shop, it's married women who buy
(Maybe I should order a new coffin...)
Someone in my family has passed away, so
I'd like a fine coffin, if I may...
What splendid work!
It looks very comfortable to sleep in.
Comfortable to sleep in!?
Oh, you mean comfortable for the departed.
Do come to me again sometime.
What brings you here this late at night?
Oh, I just wanted to thank you for the coffin.
Is something the matter?
Oh, it's just...
Newlyweds often come to thank me
for shelves or beds, but...
Coming to thank me for a coffin?
You're the first, I tell you.
After all, buying a coffin is never
a happy occasion to begin with.
And the dead can't come to say thanks, either.
The worth of a thing differs for everyone.
When a thing's worth suddenly changes one day,
it's because someone found new worth in it.
And I have found
a new worth in you.
Even if it is something you would never want,
I must obtain it,
no matter what.
I don't quite follow what you're saying, but
very well.
Nobody's ever thought so highly of my work
before you.
So I'll put my trust in you, too.
Oh no.
The coffin order with Helmut...
I forgot all about it.
Command me as you wish...
Sorry, I'm in the middle of making bread.
Come back when the shop's open, won't you?
This here's Kuchen Bakery.
Small round rolls are best for breakfast.
These big loaves of Brot over here,
are meant to be sliced thin.
Lately I've gotten into sweet breads, too.
I've got all kinds of bread here.
Bread comes in all kinds, you see...
Some made of wheat, some of rye,
some with mixed grains,
dark, dense, heavy ones, and white,
fluffy, light ones... all sorts.
Well, which you eat is a matter of taste.
In the old days, the housewives brought
their own dough, and the baker only baked
it in his oven...
Times have changed. Nowadays, money buys
you anything, and not baking at home
